about_the_game:
The Three Kingdoms Front is a text game with an idle gameplay based on the Three Kingdoms. At the beginning of the game, you have to choose a team to start the adventure. The characters in the team are composed of generals in the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military orders and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations.

Featured system:

Welfare system: Generals can be drawn for free every day, 2 ordinary draws, and 1 advanced draw

Recruitment system: Triggered by each battle victory, there are all kinds of top-quality generals

Placement system: Use high internal affairs charm for development, high intelligence and force for war, and place generals reasonably to maximize the benefits

Battle system: The more battles you challenge, in addition to the higher daily silver income, you will also have the opportunity to recruit more top-quality generals

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Simple game strategy

1. How to play?

The game is a place-and-hang gameplay. After arranging the generals' lineup, hang up to play levels, collect various generals and equipment props, and unlock more gameplay.

2. How to get more silver ingots?

》Every time you upgrade the lord from level 1 to level 10, you can get silver + ingots from the warehouse props, and the total accumulated amount can be 10,500 silver + 10,500 ingots

》Welfare interface: You can get up to 100~300 silver from advertising every day

》Welfare interface: You can get 180~360 silver from resource recycling every day

》Welfare interface: You can get 60~960 ingots from equipment recycling every day

3. How to get offline hang-up income?

Register an account first (note that you must register an account first to get offline income). The current default limit is 3 hours, and the monthly card supports a maximum limit of 8 hours

4. How to increase income?

The game has a double acceleration function. In addition to the free acceleration time every day, you can also use the free advertising mode to get more double time.
